caption:
does glutathione cream brighten skin?

A 2025 review screened 446 papers and found only 5 clinical trials of glutathione applied to the skin. The best-known one had 30 people for 10 weeks, and 3 of its 4 authors worked for the company.

Pigment readings dropped a little, and only on sun-exposed skin. No study has shown how long that lasts.

If dark spots are the goal, daily sunscreen still does more of the work.

Save this before you buy a glutathione cream.

General education only. Not medical advice.

Sources:
Khanna et al., J Clin Aesthet Dermatol 2025 (systematic review)
Watanabe et al., Clin Cosmet Investig Dermatol 2014
Dilokthornsakul et al., J Cosmet Dermatol 2019
